name: PaletteCrowwood
intent: A crow-haunted birch wood in first snow: a cold blue-white snow path cutting through near-black mossy leaf mould under pale birch bark, with a faded oxblood of rowan berries and tied ribbons as the only colour.

critic_pass1.why: The pale path reads well from above, but olive moss ground with a grey road is nearly the same picture as D and E and the moor, and the 'snow' path is warm grey, not snow.
critic_pass1.fix: road snow 15 values lighter and cooler (blue-white grey) so the first snow, not the moss, defines the place

critic_pass2.why: Darker moss ground and a cooler snow road give more contrast than pass 1, but dark green-grey ground with pale grey patches still reads close to the moor, and the oxblood barely shows on the map.
